annotations.title: Get a pitch's AI score and roast

description: Get PitchSpark's AI pitch score for one pitch: the composite (0-100), the six dimensions (market, problem, traction, moat, financials, team, each 0-100 with the model's analysis) and the Roast Room commentary when the pitch was roasted. Use when: an investor asks how PitchSpark rates a pitch, or where it is strong and weak. Prefer it over pitchspark_get_pitch_v2 when only the score is needed. Do not use for: scoring your own text (pitchspark_roast_text_v1, when enabled), what signed-in users decided (pitchspark_get_decision_summary_v1), investment advice. Limits of the data: scores are published only at 70 or above; below that pitchspark_score is null and the dimensions are withheld (dimensions_withheld "not_public"): null means no public score, not a low one. Dimensions and analyses need an API key (dimensions_withheld "key_required" without one). Roast text is filtered for personal attacks and contact details. Same access as pitchspark_get_pitch_v1: anonymous callers allowed under the daily allowance. Returns {"score":{pitch_id, company_name, pitchspark_score, scale, public_min, dimensions, dimensions_withheld, scoring_version, scored_at, roast}, "attribution"}. Each pitch this tool returns counts 1 against the daily pitch allowance (the one allowance every pitch tool shares), or 0 when the same API key (without a key, the same connection) already got that pitch today. Calls are logged, and each pitch returned is counted as a view.

id.description: The pitch id from a search result ("id").

name: pitchspark_get_score_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

available.description: false when the block is withheld: fewer than min_k distinct signed-in users (below_min_k), no source data (no_data), a read failed (unavailable), or the field is hidden pending a review (hidden_pending_review).
